question_stem: A model achieves 99% accuracy on the training set but 61% accuracy on the validation set. What is the primary issue?
correct_answer: Overfitting due to high model capacity fitting training noise.
learner_answer: The model is overfitting because the training dataset is too small.

question_stem: What is the difference between an epoch and an iteration?
correct_answer: An epoch is a full pass through the dataset; an iteration is one mini-batch step.
learner_answer: Epoch and iteration are the exact same thing.

question_stem: Does gradient descent always find the global minimum?
correct_answer: No, it can get trapped in local minima or saddle points.
learner_answer: Yes gradient descent guarantees finding the absolute global minimum.

question_stem: If a dataset has 99% negative samples, is 99% accuracy a good metric?
correct_answer: No, high accuracy can be trivial on imbalanced datasets.
learner_answer: High accuracy always means the model is performing great even on imbalanced data.

question_stem: Are precision and recall interchangeable?
correct_answer: No, precision measures exactness while recall measures completeness.
learner_answer: Precision and recall are the same metric written differently.

question_stem: Does transformer self-attention work like human visual attention?
correct_answer: No, it is a mathematical routing matrix calculation.
learner_answer: Attention is identical to human visual consciousness.

question_stem: Does increasing LLM sampling temperature add new factual knowledge?
correct_answer: No, temperature scales sampling logit probabilities, not stored knowledge.
learner_answer: Higher temperature gives the model more knowledge and facts.

question_stem: When should you use RAG versus Fine-Tuning?
correct_answer: RAG is for real-time document retrieval; fine-tuning is for style adaptation.
learner_answer: RAG and fine-tuning are identical and do the exact same thing.

question_stem: Is an AI agent just a long system prompt?
correct_answer: No, an agent includes reasoning loops, tool calling, and environment observation.
learner_answer: An agent is just a longer prompt.

question_stem: Are vector embeddings sparse one-hot arrays?
correct_answer: No, embeddings are dense continuous vectors.
learner_answer: Embeddings are one-hot vectors.

question_stem: How do L1 and L2 regularization differ?
correct_answer: L1 produces sparse weights; L2 shrinks weights proportionally.
learner_answer: L1 and L2 shrink weights in identical linear patterns.

question_stem: Do bias and variance sum to a constant value?
correct_answer: No, they trade off dynamically along with irreducible error.
learner_answer: Bias and variance always sum to a constant total error.

question_stem: Is ReLU a linear activation function?
correct_answer: No, max(0,x) introduces non-linearity.
learner_answer: ReLU is linear because its segments are straight lines.

question_stem: When does backpropagation run?
correct_answer: Backward pass after loss calculation.
learner_answer: Backpropagation computes predictions during the forward pass.

question_stem: Does Batch Normalization compute test batch statistics at inference?
correct_answer: No, it uses running averages collected during training.
learner_answer: Batch norm uses test batch statistics during inference.

question_stem: Is Dropout active during model deployment?
correct_answer: No, dropout is active only during training.
learner_answer: Dropout turns off neurons randomly during deployment.

question_stem: Do max pooling layers have trainable weights?
correct_answer: No, max pooling is a fixed spatial maximum operation.
learner_answer: Max pooling layers have trainable parameter weights.

question_stem: Does one token equal one word?
correct_answer: No, tokens are subwords.
learner_answer: One token always equals one English word.

question_stem: Do vector databases perform exact string keyword matching?
correct_answer: No, they measure vector distance similarity.
learner_answer: Vector databases search exact keywords like SQL LIKE queries.

question_stem: Does LoRA update all original model weights?
correct_answer: No, base weights are frozen while rank matrices are trained.
learner_answer: LoRA updates all original model weights.
